lectures.title: Inaugurations: infrastructure, facilities, conferences and events

items: **Noida International Airport (Phase I):** inaugurated by PM Narendra Modi on 28 March 2026 at Jewar, Gautam Buddha Nagar district; cost ₹11,200 crore; cargo terminal also inaugurated; MRO facility foundation stone laid.
**Noida International Airport commercial operations:** began on 15 June 2026; the inauguration had taken place earlier, on 28 March 2026.
**Ganga Expressway:** 594 km; Meerut to Prayagraj; inaugurated by PM Narendra Modi at Hardoi, Uttar Pradesh; initially six lanes, expandable to eight; passes through 12 districts.
**Lucknow–Kanpur Expressway:** 63 km, six lanes; inaugurated on 13 July 2026 at Jhau Kheda, Unnao district.
**Lucknow–Kanpur Expressway** is India's first expressway built using automated and intelligent machine-guided construction technology.
**India's first indigenous hydrogen-powered train:** inaugurated by PM Narendra Modi on the Jind–Sonipat section, Haryana, on 17 July 2026.
**India's first hydrogen-powered water taxi / passenger vessel:** commercial operation flagged off (began) at Namo Ghat, Varanasi, on 11 December 2025 by Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal.

**SSB infrastructure projects:** ₹170 crore infrastructure projects for CAPF were inaugurated/e-inaugurated; 554 km of border roads approved.
**77th Republic Day:** 26 January 2026; marks the day the Constitution of India came into force on 26 January 1950.
**Republic Day Parade 2026:** held at Kartavya Path, New Delhi, on 26 January 2026. Theme: “150 Years of Vande Mataram.”
**Chief Guests:** Antonio Costa, President of the European Council, and Ursula von der Leyen, President of the European Commission.
**Republic Day tableaux 2026:** 30 tableaux: 17 from States/UTs and 13 from Union Ministries. Sub-themes: “Swatantrata ka Mantra – Vande Mataram” and “Samriddhi ka Mantra – Atmanirbhar Bharat.”
Handicrafts and Folk Dances of Jammu and Kashmir
**Best tableau among Central Ministries/Departments:** Ministry of Culture – Vande Mataram: The Soul Cry of a Nation; the Ministry of Culture tableau was on “150 Years of Vande Mataram.”
**Special prize:** Central Public Works Department – Vande Mataram: Commemoration of 150 Years.
**Indian Navy Day 2025:** 4 December 2025. Theme: “Combat Ready, Cohesive, Credible, and Aatmanirbhar Force.”
**Indian Air Force 94th anniversary – “Wings Over Ganga”:** 3-day aerial display over the Ganga at Namo Ghat, Varanasi, on 22, 24 and 25 October 2026.
**IAF anniversary theme:** “Indian Air Force – Infallible, Impervious and Precise.”
**12th International Yoga Day:** 21 June 2026; officially celebrated in Kolkata, West Bengal. Theme: “Yoga for Healthy Ageing.”
**Main event:** PM Narendra Modi participated in the main event at Red Road, Kolkata, West Bengal; around 35,000 people joined the yoga session with the Prime Minister.
**Record:** the event created a new Guinness World Record.
**Origin:** United Nations declared 21 June as International Yoga Day on 11 December 2014.
**Campaign:** “100 Days, 100 Cities, 100 Organisations” encouraged regular yoga practice across India.
Theme: “Digital Agenda and Artificial Intelligence to Redesign Tourism.” Official celebrations hosted by El Salvador.
Theme: “Innovate Today, Nourish Tomorrow.” Marks the founding anniversary of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO).
Commemorates the Montreal Protocol, adopted in 1987.
**India's 80th Independence Day:** New York and New Jersey issued separate proclamations for 15 August 2026.
**Kashi Tamil Sangamam 4.0:** 2–15 December 2025; held in Varanasi; theme: “Let Us Learn Tamil – Tamil Karkalam.”
**Valedictory ceremony:** 30 December 2025; graced by Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan.
**Objective:** celebrates the longstanding movement of ideas, spirituality, learning and culture (cultural and civilisational connections) between Tamil Nadu and Kashi.
**Nature:** a Government-led cultural and educational exchange, designed as a “knowledge bridge” and people-to-people platform; aligned with the spirit of Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat.
**Organisers:** Ministry of Education is the anchor ministry; IIT Madras and Banaras Hindu University are principal knowledge partners.
**2025 edition:** focused particularly on Tamil language learning and youth engagement.
**Chinmaya Mission 75-year celebrations:** year-long celebrations in 2026 commemorating 75 years of the Chinmaya Mission.

**Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan:** 23–25 October 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi; PM Narendra Modi inaugurated the Sammelan on 23 October. The 2026 Sammelan marked 75 years of the Mission.
**Founder:** founded in 1953 by Swami Chinmayananda Saraswati.
**Swami Chinmayananda:** born on 8 May 1916 as Balakrishna Menon; he passed away on 3 August 1993.
**Teachings:** the Mission promotes the teachings of Vedanta, the Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita.

parts.t: Other cultural, spiritual and science festivals
items: **Sushruta Jayanti:** 15 July 2026; celebrates the birth anniversary of Acharya Sushruta, recognised as the “father of surgery in Ayurveda.”
**Saushrutam 2026:** 15 July 2026; inaugurated by President Droupadi Murmu at the All India Institute of Ayurveda, New Delhi.
**10th International Gita Mahotsav 2025:** 15 November–5 December 2025; held in Kurukshetra; inaugurated by Haryana CM Nayab Singh Saini.
**Dhwajarohan Utsav:** 25 November 2025; PM Narendra Modi attended the flag-hoisting ceremony at Shri Ram Janmbhoomi Mandir, Ayodhya.
**India International Science Festival 2025:** 6–9 December 2025; 11th edition held in Panchkula, Haryana.
**IISF 2025 theme:** “Vigyan Se Samruddhi: For Atmanirbhar Bharat”; intended to celebrate and advance science-led growth for a self-reliant and prosperous India.
**8th Poshan Pakhwada 2026:** 9–23 April 2026; celebrated by the Ministry of Women and Child Development under Mission Poshan 2.0.
**Poshan Pakhwada 2026 theme:** “Maximizing Brain Development in the First Six Years of Life.”
**Poshan Pakhwada national launch:** 9 April 2026; Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi; Union Minister Annpurna Devi and MoS Savitri Thakur participated.
**GSI Foundation Day:** 176th Foundation Day, 4 March 2026; Eparchaean Unconformity near Kalinjar Fort was declared a Geo-Heritage Site of National Importance during the occasion.
**National Milk Day:** 26 November 2025; Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics 2025 released in celebration of National Milk Day by MoS Prof. S. P. Singh Baghel.
**UDAN anniversary:** 21 October 2026; Regional Connectivity Scheme–UDAN completed 10 years.
**RTI Act anniversary:** 12 October 2026; completed 21 years of full implementation.
**UPSC centenary:** 1 October 2026; UPSC completed 100 years since the establishment of India's first Public Service Commission on 1 October 1926.
**Centenary event – Manthan:** 30 September–1 October 2026; two-day event at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
**Legal basis:** Government of India Act, 1919 provided for the establishment of a Public Service Commission.
**Lee Commission:** chaired by Arthur Hamilton Lee; recommended the immediate establishment of a statutory Public Service Commission in 1924.
**Early character:** initially, it was an advisory body; Chairman and members were appointed by the Secretary of State for India in London.
**First Indian in the ICS:** the first Indian to join the Indian Civil Service was Satyendranath Tagore.
**India–Japan Year of Shared Horizons:** 2027; India and Japan will celebrate 75 years of diplomatic relations.
**India–Japan diplomatic relations, 2027:** cultural, academic, youth, business and public-diplomacy events planned.
**16th India–Japan Annual Summit:** 1–3 July 2026; Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi visited New Delhi; main meeting with PM Narendra Modi held on 2 July.
**Annual summit milestone:** the 2026 visit marked 20 years of annual, alternating leadership visits.
**Rudraksh Convention Centre:** inaugurated on 15 July 2021 by PM Narendra Modi; constructed with Japanese assistance and linked to India–Japan cultural cooperation.

corrections.rocket: Lucas Philippe | INTERPOL | President of the General Assembly | Elected on 27 November 2025; succeeded Ahmed Naser Al-Raisi.
corrections.corrected: Lucas Philippe: President of INTERPOL; elected by the INTERPOL General Assembly on 27 November 2025; succeeded Ahmed Naser Al-Raisi.
corrections.checked: The General Assembly (Marrakech) elected him President of INTERPOL (of its Executive Committee), not president of the Assembly (INTERPOL, https://www.interpol.int/en/News-and-Events/News/2025/INTERPOL-General-Assembly-elects-new-Executive-Committee-President-Vice-President-and-Delegates).

corrections.rocket: GSI Foundation Day | 6 March 2026 | 176th Foundation Day; Eparchaean Unconformity near Kalinjar Fort was declared a Geo-Heritage Site of National Importance during the occasion.
corrections.corrected: GSI Foundation Day: 176th Foundation Day, 4 March 2026; Eparchaean Unconformity near Kalinjar Fort was declared a Geo-Heritage Site of National Importance during the occasion.
corrections.checked: GSI's foundation day is 4 March; the 176th was celebrated on 4 March 2026 (News On AIR, https://www.newsonair.gov.in/geological-survey-of-india-celebrates-its-176th-foundation-day-today). Some reports of the Kalinjar declaration are dated 6 March.

corrections.title: Celebrations, observances and anniversaries
corrections.rocket: Chinmaya Mission: Founded in 1953 by Swami Chinmayananda Saraswati. / The 2026 Sammelan marked 75 years of the Mission.
corrections.corrected: Both lines kept as Rocket gives them (founded in 1953; the 2026 Sammelan marked 75 years of the Mission).
corrections.checked: 1953 + 75 is 2028, not 2026. The Mission's site gives formal founding on 8 August 1953 and says the work began in 1951 (https://www.chinmayamission.com/who-we-are/swami-chinmayananda/legacy), which would make 2026 the 75th year, but no source found confirming which date the 2026 celebration counts from.
